description: Set the login password of a member of THIS tenant (admins only; ticket 1a6af89c). Identify the person by user_id or email. Pass the password as password_ref = a 1Password reference op://<vault>/<item>/<field> (PREFERRED: resolved server-side from the tenant's 1Password connection, so the value never appears in your context or any log) or, only if there is no 1Password entry, as password (plain text). The value is never returned or logged. Only works if you administer EVERY tenant the person belongs to (the login is platform-wide). Agents need an explicit permission for exactly this tool. By default all sessions of the person are ended (revoke_sessions=false keeps them) and the person gets a notice email without the password (notify=false skips it). Recorded in audit_log (who, for whom, when — no value).

notify.description: Send the person a notice email without the password (default true)

password.description: Plain text — only if there is no 1Password entry.

revoke_sessions.description: End all sessions of the person (default true)

name: set_user_password
